label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: Desks with legs and shelves, a freestanding chalkboard, ceiling fans, floor, walls and ceiling are recognizable.
The rigid, widely spaced desk grid misses the reference's denser, uneven arrangement. Repeated identical narrow wall panels do not reproduce the varied doors and windows.
Bags reach approximately desktop height, while desks and the stage backdrop are too small relative to the room and openings.
The cream/yellow walls and green/burgundy stage preserve color categories, but pale tan furniture and uniformly bright illumination miss the dark wood and strong side daylight contrast.

Box.123 is a finite mesh with eight vertices, six polygons and dimensions 1.55 × 0.64 × 0.10, bound to SceneActSurface_6. The material has a Principled BSDF connected to its surface output. Box.124 supplies separate volumetric leg geometry.
The authored view clearly evokes the supplied classroom through repeated desks, bags, fans, two-tone walls and the distinctive green-sided burgundy stage with chalkboard.

dimension_scores.evidence: The distinctive classroom composition survives, but furniture density, openings and stage construction are substantially simplified.
Desks have coherent supporting legs, books rest on tops and fans have downrods. The chalkboard's two thin supports lack a convincing freestanding base.
Major wall and stage hues remain identifiable, but pale furniture, rigid block-shaped bags and a flat curtain lose characteristic appearance.
Consistent shading gives volume, but identical furniture, blank picture frames, slab openings and rigid fabric substitutes make the room look like a blockout.
Forward-facing rows and the stage relationship are preserved; overly regular spacing and uniform side openings weaken the reference layout.
Basic desk proportions are plausible, but bags are oversized against desks and the stage occupies too little of the end wall.
Soft contact shadows are present, but flat, washed-out surfaces and diffuse illumination lose the reference's directional daylight and dark furniture contrast.
Desks, fans, bags, board and room surfaces are present. Recognizable seating, ceiling beams and tube fixtures, detailed openings, and stage-side furnishings are missing.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
